preconditions.description: The input values n and k must satisfy the condition 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 100000.

postconditions.expression: len(set(abs(p[i] - p[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1))) == k
postconditions.description: The output permutation must have exactly k distinct absolute differences between consecutive elements.

postconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
postconditions.description: The output permutation must consist of n distinct positive integers, each not larger than n.
